headings: # When the Adult Voice Feels Fake

rows.label: Altered states · try 3, not in (alone 100% AI, medium; the h1 with it 100% Human, 1,058)
rows.text: For some people it only stops feeling fake in an altered state, like on mushrooms or deep in meditation. All of a sudden your little one is right there, and the love or grief that sounded like therapy talk is just obvious. Old memories might come up too. They can feel totally real, but that alone doesn't prove they happened. I'd still hang on to what you felt, even once it's gone, and try to bring a little of it into your normal life.

source.quote: For some people, the adult voice can stay fake in ordinary consciousness and become real only in an altered state. The child may suddenly feel unmistakably present; love, grief, innocence, or protection that sounded like therapy language can become emotionally obvious. If that happens, don’t throw it away afterward just because your sober mind cannot reproduce the feeling. Also don’t turn the intensity into proof that every image or memory is literal. The next task is transfer: can any of what became real remain available in ordinary life?
